info.title: WildNetwork open API
info.description: Read access to WildNetwork's live map and effort-corrected measures, and authenticated push of WDX detection events. Responses mix sources, including BirdWeather detections shown with BirdWeather's agreement for display only: use the API to view and explore, and the citable open data releases (https://wildnetwork.arunrajiah.com/data) for analysis and redistribution. No key is needed to read; please keep to about one request per second.

200.description: live flag, last pull time, connector states, totals

get.summary: Live detections as GeoJSON (a sample of the newest, see /methods)

parameters.name: merge
parameters.description: 1 = merge BirdWeather detections of one species at the same 1 degree position within 15 minutes into one point with a count n

200.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection; properties: id, t, sci, common, conf (machine detections only), human (true for human observations, which have no conf), count (animals, when reported), trusted (the source's own verification flag), unmapped (common name not yet mapped to a species), credit (required credit line, e.g. for Acartia), source, group, media, mediaType. Acartia sightings appear only once 24 hours old, at 0.1 degree.

post.summary: Push WDX 0.1 or 0.2 detection events (single event, JSON array or NDJSON, up to 5,000 per request)
Get a push key for a device (shown once, restricted to one source system; 5 per IP per day)
Register a device (a WildNetwork Base or any recorder): returns deviceId and a push key, shown once. 5 per IP per day, shared with /register

get.summary: Registered devices and their latest health report (no hardware ids, contacts or locations)

post.summary: Send a health report (WDX device status, one record or an array). deviceId must be the key's device

get.summary: Sensor locations as GeoJSON (BirdWeather stations rounded to 1 degree, without names)
Species in the live window, or search all species

200.description: array of { scientificName, vernacularName, count, deployments }

get.summary: One species, last 30 days, effort corrected: daily index, range centre, weather at the centre, change per cell, text summary
Weekly frames for the past year: share per 5 degree cell and range centre per continent

200.description: frames[]: week, total, index, cells [lat, lon, detections, per-1000 share], centroids

get.summary: Heard versus seen: recordings against human records in the same cells and weeks

200.description: region, weeks[], r, lag, arrival per source

get.summary: Arrival, peak and departure weeks per species and 5 degree cell

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: with lon: only the cell containing this point

200.description: arrivals[]: scientificName, cell, arrivalWeek, arrivalLow and arrivalHigh (90% interval), arrivalSupport (0 to 1: share of resampled series that still show a season; below 0.5 is weak), peakWeek, departureWeek and counts

get.summary: What is changing now: moving, surging and fading, new and latest arrivals, most recorded, text summary
Which 5 degree cells are watched by recordings, sightings, both, or too thin
Species photo and short description (Wikipedia, iNaturalist)

parameters.name: names
parameters.description: comma separated scientific names, up to 40

get.summary: GBIF datasets seen in the live pull, for credits
